references.decision: Reviewed its complete spatial and speed modules. Its Doppler implementation uses owned scene signals, propagation-delay buffers/seek and per-ear output. This phase uses CrySirror transport/resampling and does not import/copy that scene implementation.

references.scope: radial velocity projections, factor and speed-of-sound formula; CrySirror adds bilateral 99%-of-c and target-ratio safety bounds
DopplerFactor is separate from user frequency and is applied to resampling; listener/emitter radial velocity observations

implementation: New bounded engine-owned direct radial model, output-clock interpolation and scoped pose inference. Existing mixer/stream/DSP workers own PCM. No new dependency, SDK, native VM opcode or legacy audio host.
